name: Napa cabbage (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Napa cabbage (Brassica rapa var. pekinensis) [Vegetables] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 169979 (Cabbage, chinese pe-tsai, raw) - full nutrient panel: sugars, 18 amino acids, vitamins, minerals
Ferreres et al., J Food Nutr Res sciepub jfnr/2/11/5 (organic acids in Brassica rapa greens/tops - species proxy)
MDPI Horticulturae 2023, 9(12):1264 doi:10.3390/horticulturae9121264 (Chinese cabbage malic/citric/oxalic acid variation)
Wang et al. Hortic Environ Biotechnol doi:10.1007/s13580-020-00294-y (sugar accumulation, glucose>fructose>>sucrose)
Frontiers Mol Biosci doi:10.3389/fmolb.2022.953189 (B. rapa sugar/organic-acid metabolic diversity)
JAFC doi:10.1021/acs.jafc.6b01323 & PMC6915346 (pekinensis metabolite profiling: malic dominant TCA acid)
provenance.curation_notes: Dominant carbon/energy sources are the free hexoses glucose + fructose (~1.2 g/100g combined, roughly equal, sucrose minor) plus malic acid as the leading organic acid; glutamate is the principal amino-acid nitrogen source. USDA total sugars (1.41 g) apportioned into specific sugars by published Chinese-cabbage hexose>>sucrose ratios (medium confidence). curation_added: malic acid (dominant organic acid - was absent)
fumaric acid / succinic acid (minor TCA acids)
riboflavin, pantothenic acid, vitamin E, vitamin K, folate quantified

curation_removed.name: Retinol
curation_removed.reason: Animal vitamer of vitamin A; plants supply provitamin A as beta-/alpha-carotene, not preformed retinol. FooDB predicted/implausible for a plant matrix. Carotenes retained.

curation_removed.name: D-Serine
curation_removed.reason: Non-proteinogenic D-enantiomer; biologically implausible in plant protein. Replaced with L-serine (USDA).

curation_removed.name: Fe2+ mitochondria
curation_removed.reason: Compartment-tagged duplicate iron entry (BiGG/FooDB artifact); iron consolidated to a single elemental entry.

curation_removed.name: Iron (Fe3+)
curation_removed.reason: Redundant duplicate iron species; consolidated into one 'iron' entry (0.31 mg/100g).

curation_removed.name: Co2+
curation_removed.reason: Cobalt is an ultratrace non-nutrient for a plant matrix (relevant only via B12, which plants do not synthesize); FooDB noise.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
